properties.displayName: UAV S11 - Unauthorized Weapon Command (ARM/FIRE without 2-person control)
properties.description: 2인통제 우회 또는 비인가 운영자/페이로드/무기로 ARM/FIRE 명령 탐지. armed_by == fire_requester(자기승인), 비인가 OperatorId, 비인가 WeaponId, 비인가 PayloadConfig. MITRE: T0831 Manipulation of Control
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let ApprovedArm = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Arm_Operator_List') | project OperatorId;
let ApprovedWeapons = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Weapon_List') | project WeaponId;
let ApprovedPayloads = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Payload_Config_List') | project PayloadConfig;
UAVWeapon_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType in ('arm', 'fire')
| extend isSelfApproval = (armed_by == fire_requester)
| extend isUnknownOp = OperatorId !in (ApprovedArm)
| extend isUnknownWeapon = WeaponId !in (ApprovedWeapons)
| extend isUnknownPayload = PayloadConfig !in (ApprovedPayloads)
| where isSelfApproval or isUnknownOp or isUnknownWeapon or isUnknownPayload
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isSelfApproval, "무장_2인통제_자기승인",
    isUnknownOp, strcat("무장_비인가_운영자_", OperatorId),
    isUnknownWeapon, strcat("무장_비인가_WeaponId_", WeaponId),
    strcat("무장_비인가_PayloadConfig_", PayloadConfig))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, OperatorId, WeaponId, PayloadConfig,
    EventType, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S11 - Unauthorized Weapon Command (ARM/FIRE without 2-person control) - {{OperatorId}}
